domain: Japanese anagama wood-kiln ceramics — multi-day atmospheric firing, kiln loading geometry, pyrometric cones, firing-curve discipline
axioms: Committed transitions are one-way; irreversibility must be by design, never by accident
Every state mutation must leave an entry in the firing record — an unlogged stoke makes replay certify a curve that never happened
Atmosphere is shared: budgets, locks, and the event log degrade every co-resident run together
Failures bake in during unobserved windows between checkpoints and are only discoverable at unloading
A gate passed on the potter's confidence (self-report) is no gate; only a cone pack in the chamber (executed verification) counts
Mutual exclusion held only by a staleness timer is no mutual exclusion
failure_mode: Treats all unevented mutations as defects, but some (telemetry counters, replay-capture tolerance for unmigrated DBs) are deliberate engineering trade-offs a potter has no analog for
Cannot weigh the performance cost of making every mutation transactional-with-events
Skipped deep review of internal/agency, coordination beyond lock events, scoring, and portfolio
Reads markdown skills only as gate definitions — blind to corpus-level drift and duplication
